starting_location.description: A peaceful village surrounded by lush forests and rolling hills.

avalanche.description: A sudden avalanche triggered by a footstep, it's fast and deadly.

starting_location.generated_description: The sun dips low, painting the village of Oakhaven in hues of orange and gold. Smoke curls lazily from thatched roofs, carrying the scent of roasting meats and hearth fires. Lush forests, thick with ancient trees, cradle the village in their verdant embrace. Rolling hills, dotted with grazing sheep, provide a gentle barrier against the world's harshness. A palpable sense of tranquility hangs in the air, a promise of warmth and respite for weary travelers.

dark_forest.description: A dense, shadowy forest where sunlight struggles to penetrate.

torch.name: torch
torch.description: A torch to light the way.

mystic_lake.description: A serene lake, rumored to hold magical properties.
mystic_lake.generated_description: The Whispering Lake shimmers, its surface a flawless mirror reflecting a sky perpetually kissed by twilight. Legend speaks of its waters granting visions, weaving dreams into reality for those who dare to drink. Ancient, gnarled trees guard the shore, their roots entangled with the very earth, their leaves whispering secrets to the restless breeze. A palpable stillness hangs in the air, broken only by the croak of unseen frogs and the rustle of something unseen just beyond the treeline. The air itself hums with a faint, otherworldly energy, a siren's call to the curious and the desperate alike.

abandoned_mine.description: An old mine, long abandoned and filled with dangers.

rockfall.description: Loose rocks fall from the ceiling.

ancient_ruins.description: The crumbling remains of an ancient civilization.
ancient_ruins.generated_description: Dust devils danced across the cracked flagstones of what was once a grand plaza. Shattered statues, their features eroded by time, lay half-buried in the shifting sands. Twisted columns, etched with indecipherable glyphs, clawed at the unforgiving sky. A chilling wind whispered through the skeletal ruins, carrying the ghosts of forgotten glories. The air hung heavy with the scent of decay and the unspoken promise of forgotten dangers.

mountain_pass.description: A treacherous mountain pass with steep cliffs and strong winds.

haunted_graveyard.description: A graveyard filled with the restless dead.

cavern_entrance.description: The entrance to a dark cavern.

torch.description: A torch to light the way.

sunken_temple.description: A temple submerged beneath the water.
sunken_temple.generated_description: Sunlight fractured into shimmering beams, barely piercing the murky depths. A colossal temple, swallowed by the lake, loomed before you, its stone facade draped in emerald algae. Grotesque carvings of forgotten gods leered from the walls, hinting at forgotten rituals. A silent, spectral presence permeated the water, whispering tales of hubris and decay. Within those submerged halls, untold treasures and unimaginable horrors await those brave or foolish enough to enter.

crystal_caves.description: A network of sparkling crystal caves.

old_library.description: A vast library filled with ancient texts.
old_library.generated_description: The air hangs heavy with the scent of aged parchment and dust within these hallowed halls. Shadows dance in the flickering light of braziers, illuminating towering shelves that stretch into a seemingly endless expanse. Runes and archaic symbols adorn the spines of countless tomes, whispering secrets of forgotten ages. A hushed silence blankets the room, broken only by the occasional rustle of pages turning or the distant echo of a dripping leak. Danger and knowledge reside here, a potent combination awaiting those brave enough to explore.
